recipe.label: Modern Gradient

traits.texture: broad diffuse color fields with subtle uniform fine grain and gently feathered boundaries
traits.composition: reduce the reference to a few large color masses, retaining its dominant directional flow and horizon relationship
traits.lighting: even diffuse luminosity with no strong hard-edged specular source

review_checks: Large blended color fields establish the image
Fine grain is restrained and gradients remain smooth
limitations: The scene is intentionally abstracted; no exact color profile, banding-free display guarantee or vector gradient mesh is supplied.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
